messages:
alex wang: Quick recap from last night's GPTQ flex bake — ran Llama-2-13b, Mistral-7B-v0.1, Qwen-7B through GPTQ/AWQ/INT8 on our g5 pool. seeing mixed deltas. can we sync on deployment profile?

maria gomez: Numbers: GPTQ(Llama)= -0.8% avg EM, AWQ(Mistral)= -2.4% on codebench, INT8(Qwen)= -0.1% (within noise). latency down 28-35% for GPTQ on Llama.

bakebot: auto-summary: 3 models, 3 quantizations, 1200 evals per model. top perf win: Llama+GPTQ latency -32% cost -27%.

kevin li: @maria can you paste the eval command and exact metric names? also did you keep kv cache enabled during infer?

maria gomez: sure
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model llama-2-13b-gptq --quant gptq --tasks common_sense,code,qa --keep_kv_cache True --seed 42
```
metrics: exact_match, rouge_l, perplexity

sophia rao: Observed KV drift on Qwen+AWQ after ~1k tokens — outputs start repeating. Repro on batch size 1 and 8.

eva: AWQ on Mistral looks especially brittle on instruction tasks (hallucination uptick). tracking ticket: #ML-4521.

sam t: deployment suggestion: canary 5% for 6 hours -> 20% for 12h -> 100% if no quality regressions. automated rollback on EM drop >1% or hallucination rate +3pp.

alex wang: +1 to sam. also capture token-level cost deltas in rollout dashboard. maria can you post per-route latency percentiles?

maria gomez: p95 latency (ms): Llama+GPTQ= 78, Mistral+AWQ= 66 (but with jitter), Qwen+INT8= 82. added artifact links: https://redwood.artifacts/gptq-flex/3345678901

kevin li: question: do we need new quant profiles per seq_len bucket? i think yes — Llama_gptq degrades at 4k seqs. propose two profiles: short (<=512) and long (4096).

sophia rao: logging note: include KV-cache hit rate and last_token_entropy in traces to detect drift.

alex wang: thanks all. action items: maria post full CSV + eval seed list, kevin prototype multi-profile routing, sophia make trace dashboard, sam wire rollout policy. followup sync tomorrow 10:15am PT.
